name: Performance: effects off
about: Values changed in place inside Pack/Bootup.pack > Env/env.sgenvb (AAMP files): the open world's (Master_Field: master_field, common) and the shrines' (Master_Cdungeon: d_frequentuse). Not changed: postfx/no_projectionshadow.bgsdw (ambient occlusion) and the indoor set I_FrequenUse's postfx/i_frequentuse.baglblm (bloom), so wherever the game uses those, the effect stays on; the UI, icon and viewer files stay too. Shipping Pack/Bootup.pack makes Savage Wind 0.4.1-alpha.4 skip its HUD button letters and its voice size-table fix (docs/performance.md).
